name: SegmentedControl
purpose: Mutually exclusive choice shown as joined segments, icon-only or icon-and-text. Replaces the sort direction pair and the capture mode segment. B's ToggleGroup (single type) is merged here. Also (choice): Single-choice group of segments with one value always selected. Recorded uses: filter Show (All, Active, Done), Date field (Created, Updated), tri-state refine (Any, With, Without), theme (System, Light, Dark) and Screenshots mode (Full screen, Region). Merge record: from A SegmentedControl (kept with the variant axis; the surfaceThumb look is kept as a distinct look until its thumb colour is measured, because the catalogue records it as its own look; required aria-label added per the critique). From B Segmented (name and size axis adopted; B's fold of surfaceThumb into the accent thumb is not adopted, per the critique). Sources: A SegmentedControl, B Segmented.
base: Radix RadioGroup styled as shadcn ToggleGroup segments

values.when: Selected segment accent-500 fill with on-accent text and a lift shadow. Sort direction (Ascending and Descending).
Selected segment white (oklch 1 0 0) pill with oklch 0.26 text. Capture mode (Full screen and Region). Kept as a separate tone because the look is visible; B folded it into accent.
Square icon-only segments, 25 wide by 23 high (measured). Sort direction arrow_upward and arrow_downward.
Labelled segments, 23px high. Capture mode Full screen and Region.

Text-only segments. Selected background oklch(0.6 0.2 255), text oklch(0.99 0.005 255); unselected text oklch(0.46 0.013 262); radius 4.375px. Covers 'segmented control, text-only, default size' and 'segmented control, small tri-state'.

Each segment has a leading icon and a label (icon 15px on the theme row). Used for theme (row 28) and Screenshots mode (row 37). Selected and track colour not recorded for the theme row; the thumb may collapse to accent if measured as accent.
Segments 19px high, font 600 11px/16.5px, inside a w-40 shrink-0 container (tri-state refine rows, 44x19 segments). The caller wraps it.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; icon?: IconName; label?: string; ariaLabel: string; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.description: Segments. Without label the group is icon-only. Sort items use aria-label Ascending and Descending.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the whole group (sort direction while sort is manual: opacity 40%, no pointer events).

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Segments in order. icon is used by the surfaceThumb variant (A's icon per segment; B's optional icon).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required group name: 'Show', 'Date field', 'Theme', 'Screenshots mode'; the tri-state group name is open.

states: selected segment (accent background on the text variant, on-accent text)

keyboard: Tab enters the group on the selected segment. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move and select (ArrowUp and ArrowDown if vertical). Space selects. / Tab enters the group on the selected item.
